notes: Independent review by Claude Code, session cc-39fac3, 23 September 2026, of the extraction by cc-442dc5 and Codex session a71f92. The review read the published-layout PDF (Ann. of Math. 189 (2019), 393–526, the version the extraction read) in full again with four checkers. Statements: 69 corrected; locators: 58. Library citations all exist at the pinned commits. Statuses: items 116 and 120 planned → missing (the cited stages do not plan them; they coincide with PAPER-YUN-ZHANG-17/34 and /35). The extraction's repairs are sound except the gloss added to item 70, and its repair of Theorem 7.5 (E28) needs a further step. 50 new items (1 planned, 49 missing). All 37 existing source issues confirmed; E10 reclassified from gap to error ('Sht = ⋃ ≤κSht' is false when r < #Σ∞), E17 to a misprint, E25 to affect nothing; E6 depends on an unstated coweight convention; E20's extra bound is unnecessary; E22 fails only for empty N_d. 34 new source issues, among them Remark 4.5 false when Σ∞ = ∅, a gap in applying Theorem 2.2/Lemma 2.3 in (7.10) (h□ at R is not left Iwahori-invariant; repairable via Lemma 2.6), the twist in the proof of Lemma 3.6 with swapped indices, (3.17) canonical only for single preimages, (5.5) not an open embedding when R ≠ ∅, the smoothness claim in Proposition 7.1(2) needing d′ ≥ 2g′ − 1, and misprints.
